material_definitions: The study investigates aliovalent doping in Li+ conducting argyrodites through the substitution of P5+ with Si4+.
The solid solutions are represented by the general formula Li6+xP1-xSixS5X where X is a halide like Br or Cl.
This substitution increases the Li+ concentration and its occupancy on the transition state for hopping, enhancing transport.
Structural characterization was performed using X-ray and neutron diffraction, while transport properties were measured via electrochemical impedance spectroscopy.
Increasing the Si4+ content leads to an expansion of the unit cell and an enhancement of the ionic conductivity to values exceeding 2 mS cm-1.
warnings: Temperature was not explicitly mentioned in the provided text.
The conductivity value was described as 'greater than 2'.

material_definitions: The study investigates the argyrodite-type solid electrolyte series Li6+xP1-xSixS5Br.
Ionic conductivity was evaluated using temperature-dependent impedance spectroscopy from 1 MHz down to low frequencies.
Substitution of P5+ with Si4+ increases the Li+ content and optimizes ionic transport.
The impedance spectra were fit with an equivalent circuit consisting of a parallel CPE/resistor in series with a CPE.
Enhanced Li+-Li+ correlation and coulombic repulsion are suggested as reasons for increased conductivity.
